component.name: VariPuck S6 Gimbal Mount
component.description: The VariPuck fits between your weapon and the ship hardpoint to transform a fixed weapon mount into a gimballed mount, allowing the pilot to independently aim their weapon’s fire. VariPucks will accept any weapon the same size as the hardpoint it is mounting to.

component.name: RSI Medusa Cannon
component.description: Building on centuries of RSI weapon technology, the Perseus utilizes bespoke size 8 Medusa Cannons that deliver devastating salvos of ballistic fire, capable of starting fights just as easily as ending them. These custom made RSI cannons excel at punishing larger targets at long, making it a formidable battlefield equalizer.
